summary: Microsoft Fabricと関連データ基盤は、Fabric IQをMicrosoft Copilotに組み込み、Power BI Desktopでのエージェント型アプリ作成、Fabricの監視・共有・運用機能、データベース管理機能を一括で拡充した。Fabric IQのCopilot ChatとCowork連携は本日GAで追加のAIトークン費用なし、Power BIの新しいアプリ作成体験やIQ sharing、Observability、Database Hubなどはプレビュー中心で順次提供される。さらにAzure SQL Database HyperscaleやSQL Server on Azure LocalでもGA/previewの更新があり、Copilotやエージェント向けのデータ基盤をFabricとSQL全体で強化する内容だ。
keyPoints: Fabric IQをMicrosoft Copilotに統合し、Copilot ChatとCoworkでは本日GAになった。FabricのAIインサイトを追加のAIトークン費用なしで利用でき、Code体験への統合はFrontier program経由で近日提供される。

Power BI Desktopに、自然言語でアプリを生成し、リアルタイムにプレビュー・編集してFabricへ公開できるagentic app creationを導入した。数週間以内のプレビューではPower BI Pro、Power BI Premium Per User、Microsoft Fabric capacityの各顧客が対象で、追加料金なしで1アプリ当たり最大1 GBのFabric AppsとFabric Database機能を使える。
Fabric側では、IQ sharingがプレビューになり、Salesforce Data Cloud 360との双方向統合もプレビュー、Google BigQuery mirroringはGAになった。加えてdata engineering agentとObservability in Fabricもプレビューとして投入され、共有・変換・監視の自動化を強化する。

データベース分野では、Database Hub in Fabricがプレビュー、Azure上のSQL/PostgreSQL向けdatabase agentsは近日プレビュー予定となった。Azure SQL Database Hyperscaleではserverless auto-pauseがプレビュー、192 vCoreとDiskANN vector indexesはGA、さらにSQL Server on Azure LocalとALDOもGAになった。
significance: Copilotを自社データに基づいて動かしたい企業、Power BI利用者、データエンジニア、データベース管理者に影響する更新だ。Fabric IQがCopilotや各種エージェントに共通の業務文脈を与え、Fabric AppsやDatabase Hubが既存の権限や信頼済みロジックを保ちながらアプリ構築や運用管理を進めやすくするため、分析だけでなく開発・監視・最適化まで同じ基盤上で扱いやすくなる。
summaryEn: Microsoft Fabric and its related data platform are being expanded with Fabric IQ integration into Microsoft Copilot, agentic app creation in Power BI Desktop, stronger Fabric observability, sharing, and operations features, and new database management capabilities. Fabric IQ in Copilot Chat and Cowork is generally available today with no additional AI token cost, while the new Power BI app creation experience, IQ sharing, Observability, and Database Hub are rolling out mainly as previews. Azure SQL Database Hyperscale and SQL Server on Azure Local also received GA and preview updates, broadening the Fabric and SQL foundation for Copilot and agents.
keyPointsEn: Fabric IQ is being integrated into Microsoft Copilot, with Copilot Chat and Cowork generally available today. Customers can use Fabric AI insights without additional AI token costs, and integration into the Code experience is coming soon through the Frontier program.

Power BI Desktop is getting agentic app creation that lets users generate apps in natural language, preview and edit them in real time, and publish them to Fabric. In the preview coming in the next few weeks, Power BI Pro, Power BI Premium Per User, and Microsoft Fabric capacity customers can use Fabric Apps and Fabric Database capabilities at no extra cost, up to 1 GB per app.

On the Fabric side, IQ sharing is entering preview, bidirectional integration with Salesforce Data Cloud 360 is also in preview, and Google BigQuery mirroring is now generally available. The data engineering agent and Observability in Fabric are also in preview, strengthening automation for sharing, transformation, and monitoring.

For databases, Database Hub in Fabric is in preview, and database agents for SQL and PostgreSQL on Azure are coming soon in preview. In Azure SQL Database Hyperscale, serverless auto-pause is in preview, while 192 vCore and DiskANN vector indexes are generally available, and SQL Server on Azure Local and ALDO are also now generally available.
significanceEn: These updates matter to organizations that want to run Copilot on top of their own data, as well as to Power BI users, data engineers, and database administrators. Fabric IQ gives Copilot and other agents a shared business context, while Fabric Apps and Database Hub make it easier to build applications and manage operations without losing existing permissions and trusted logic, so analysis, development, monitoring, and optimization can be handled more consistently on the same platform.
